summary: Iteration 17 - Complete React Frontend Rebuild Testing. All 27 features tested successfully. Auth works with role-based routing (users→/dashboard, admins→/admin/dashboard). Protected routes redirect to /login. User dashboard shows Quick Start, stats cards, strategy list, paper trades. Admin dashboard shows data pipeline stats, platform stats, screener analytics. All pages fully responsive at 375px minimum width. Dark Bloomberg terminal theme with signal green primary color renders correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 tested complete React frontend rebuild. Two separate experiences verified: (1) User dashboard at /dashboard with strategies, paper trades, templates, strategy builder, backtest pages. (2) Admin panel at /admin/dashboard and /admin/users with system stats and user management. Auth flow uses JWT with role-based routing. Tokens in React state only. All interactive elements have data-testid attributes. Mobile responsive at 375px. Dark theme with signal green (#00E676 variant) primary color.

notes.token_persistence: Tokens are stored in React context only (memory), so hard navigation (page refresh or manual URL change) will lose auth state. This is by design as per requirements (NOT localStorage).
notes.admin_panel_link: Admin users see 'Admin Panel' link in user sidebar when viewing user dashboard, which is correct behavior for admins who can access both panels.
notes.empty_state: Empty state UI shown when user has no strategies - tested via admin user dashboard showing 'No strategies yet' with Build Strategy/Browse Templates CTAs.
notes.screener_analytics: Admin dashboard shows screener preset runs and symbol matches from previous testing sessions.
